consequence.statement: Ambient now uses REDIRECT instead of TPROXY for traffic redirection; for most users this has no impact.

assertion.statement: Ambient's traffic redirection method changed from TPROXY to REDIRECT; for most users no impact, and it fixes some TPROXY compatibility issues.
